name: The Chart-Keepers of the Wood
description: The Chart-Keepers are Lethai-al pathweavers, Tulkani story-singers, and a few Aeler outcasts who have joined to preserve and curate the old star-roads of the Valewood and the Ways Between. They do not map the land for conquest; they map it for memory. Their charts are woven from silk and twine, and they are never sold—only lent, and only to those who carry a true story back. They are the memory of the forest.
location: Valewood, the Ways Between, and the Aelinnel courts
leverage: Access to star-roads, passage through the Valewood, knowledge of the Hollow's shifting paths, and safe refuge in the deep wood.
debtTrigger: When Obligation fills, the Chart-Keepers ask for a 'truth'—the single most dangerous piece of information you have learned on your journey. They will weave it into their maps, and the map will remember it forever.
quirk: Each Chart-Keeper's left hand is stained with a different color—the stain is from the sap of a specific star-road tree, and it cannot be washed off, only cut out.
keyNPCs: Map-Walker Sila (a Lethai-al who has walked every road she has mapped, and who never sleeps in the same place twice)
The Weaver (a Tulkani knot-keeper who ties the stories into the map's skeleton)
Korv (an Aeler outcast who has not seen the sky in nine years—he maps the Ways Between by pressure and breath alone)
hooks: A section of the star-road has begun to 'phase'—it appears and disappears, and something is walking the gaps. The Chart-Keepers need an explorer to mark the new path.
A powerful Thepyrgos scholar has offered to buy the entire Chart-Keeper's archive. The Weaver is furious and heartbroken.
A Aelaerem hedge-witch has found a way to read the maps backwards, and she is using them to walk into the Hollow rather than around it.
